name: react-native
extractedFrom: Newly created — the first pack on the app axis. Versions were confirmed from expo@57.0.29's bundledNativeModules.json and expo-template-default@sdk-57

exampleDomain.note: Every pack and seam uses the same example domain. The app is also a client calling the same API, so it uses the same vocabulary as the web screen axis

fixesVariantsNote: The Expo managed workflow + Expo Router are premises of the whole pack (file routes · Stack.Protected · config plugins). Do not assemble it for a project that chose bare React Native with a hand-built React Navigation setup, Redux, or SWR

resources.nav: Adding a screen · layouts (Stack/Tabs) · protected routes (Stack.Protected) · receiving deep links and validating paths · screen error boundaries
The loading·empty·error states of a data screen · pull to refresh · list performance (FlatList) · keyboard·safe area
QueryClient for RN (focus·online managers) · idempotency keys · the offline mutation queue (outbox) and resending
Storing tokens (expo-secure-store) · what must not go in a plaintext store · what to wipe on sign-out
Pairing runtime permissions with config plugin declarations · the denied·permanently-denied flow · location · camera · push token issuance
Showing web content in a WebView · validating message origins · restricting navigation · the scope of injected scripts
The only module that reads environment values (EXPO_PUBLIC_*) · tsconfig path aliases · jest-expo + Testing Library screen tests · mocking native modules
EAS Build profiles · what can and cannot ship over OTA (EAS Update) · runtimeVersion · the forced-update decision

seamSlotsNote: When the shape (appShell) is rn-webview·rn-native-screens the seam creates one more file, shell-bridge.md — the web ↔ native message schema is a function of the web screen axis and the shape, so it cannot live in the pack. For cross-platform it is not created
